sceneConcept: A tired twenty-four-year-old Chinese night-shift customer-service agent stands alone against a transparent background. Her dark-grey hair is tied in a low ponytail, and thick eyebrows and brown eyes subtly echo Miao Tiecheng. She wears a blue cardigan over a tucked white collared work shirt, adjusts one earcup of a plain microphone headset and maintains a restrained service expression under soft even frontal light without a badge, screens or readable text. Visual refresh: an oversized color-block streetwear jacket and a conspicuous modular call-center headset.
